book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌa Ane veize Kuraro
Iesuꞌa ḡoere ꞌahi ziroteꞌe enogano, adure ḡohani ḡianadu kuraro, “Mama, madaḡaꞌe maha. Ubugoꞌa ḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihozifine, ḡaeꞌa Ubugoꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihozoꞌi.
Mazaḡa ḡaeꞌa Ubuga haroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa ḡabone tuḡutuḡu zenoga veize, vaze niduꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa Ubuga haro.
Ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hideꞌeteꞌe ibiḡaꞌe vazeꞌa ḡa, Badiꞌa tibuhuga ebu ḡaeꞌa tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa, Iesu Keriso edereꞌeteꞌe raꞌohe.
Ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe gauḡaꞌe eḡeꞌa hauḡiro. ꞌOugadu e raha ꞌada ḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihoziro.
Mama, raha zu aduga ꞌizema haḡaogano niheꞌe niḡo teite mae ḡihiniroteꞌe teige, izidi zuni niheꞌe niḡo teite mae ḡihinoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa Ane Tahiꞌatahiꞌa veize Kuraro
“E ḡaꞌa raha ꞌadao iniroteꞌe azaḡa mazao ḡae moneo rae fureniro. Zeꞌe ḡae tahiꞌatahiꞌa rae reiro, ebu ḡaeꞌa ze iniro, zu ze ḡae ḡoere hegotiro.
Izidi ze ḡaꞌa iniroteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe ḡae mazaonoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa.
Mazaḡa ḡaꞌa ihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa eḡeꞌa ziro ebu zeḡeꞌa mae ḡihiniro. Ze eḡeꞌa ḡae mazaonoꞌo arirotaꞌaꞌe hube hune ederiro, zu ḡaeꞌa eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe mae ḡihiniro.
E zeḡe veize kurauꞌohe. E raha azaḡa veize mene kurauꞌohe, rehano ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe azaḡa veize kurauꞌohe, mazaḡa zeꞌe ḡae tahiꞌatahiꞌa.
Eḡe ḡau niduꞌaꞌe ḡae ḡau, ebu ḡae ḡau niduꞌaꞌe eḡe ḡau. Ze eꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae raꞌohe.
Eꞌe raha ꞌada mene bare radiꞌuma ebu ḡae vaḡe amiꞌuma. Rehano zeꞌe raha ꞌada radiꞌuma. Mama Zaḡoḡa, ḡa niḡo iniro. Ḡae niḡano ze biroꞌi ebu ḡa eḡe teite tiburaroteꞌe teige, zeḡe niduꞌa mae tibuzoꞌi.

E zeḡe teite radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe niḡa inaraḡa hina ze faine biriro zu taufiro, eꞌanoꞌo zeḡe niduꞌa mene dauḡiro. Rehano tiba daꞌo ruineꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa uꞌa diuḡiro. ꞌOugadu Buka Zaḡoḡano mirihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudaro.
Izidi e ḡae vaḡe amiꞌuma. Eꞌe raha ꞌada zeḡe veize ꞌahige kurauꞌohe, mazaḡa e matuꞌe rudauꞌeteꞌe teige, zeḡe zuni matuꞌuꞌa iriꞌavozoga veize raꞌohe.
E ḡoereḡo ze ziniro, rehano raha azaḡaniꞌa ze heꞌeheꞌeziro, mazaḡa eꞌe mene raha azaḡa moneo teige, zeꞌe mene raha azaḡa moneo raꞌohe.
E ḡaꞌa ze rahaonoꞌo zamaze vaḡizoga veize mene umiꞌeꞌohe, rehano Satani mazaonoꞌo ze biroga veize umiꞌeꞌohe.
Eꞌe mene raha azaḡa moneo teige, zeḡe zuni mene raha azaḡa moneo raꞌohe.
Ze ḡoere huga hina zaḡozaḡozoꞌi. Ḡae ḡoereꞌe huga.
Ḡaeꞌa e raha ꞌada tuḡuhiroteꞌe teige, eḡeꞌa ze raha azaḡa mazao tuḡuziro.
Zeḡe veize e eḡeꞌa bare zaḡozaḡoheꞌohe, mazaḡa zeḡe zuni ḡoere huga hina zaḡozaḡozoga veize raꞌohe.”
Fieꞌeteꞌe Azaḡa veize Kuraro
“E eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa veize daꞌo mene kurauꞌohe, rehano ze ḡoere egadu eḡe mazao fiteꞌe azaḡa veize zuni kurauꞌohe.

Mama, ḡa eḡe teite tiburaroteꞌe zu e ḡae teite tiburaroteꞌe teige, zeḡe niduꞌa tiburafine kurauꞌohe. Ebu zeḡe zuni emeḡe teite tiburanadu raha azaḡaniꞌa ḡa eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe mae ḡihinoga veize kurauꞌohe.
Ḡa eꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihoziroteꞌe teige, eḡe zuni zeꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihoziro, mazaḡa emeꞌe tiburaroteꞌe teige, zeḡe zuni tiburafine raꞌohe.

E zeḡe teite tiburaro zu ḡa eḡe teite tiburaro. E zeḡe niduꞌa hube hune tiburanoga veize kurauꞌohe. Mazaḡa ḡaeꞌa e tuḡuhiroteꞌe ebu e zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige, ḡaeꞌa zeḡe zuni zamare borofeꞌetaꞌaꞌe raha azaḡaniꞌa ederifine raꞌohe.

Mama, e ḡaeꞌa iniroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe eḡeꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano eḡe teite radoga urateꞌohe. Ebu ꞌizema raha zu adure haḡaogano ḡaeꞌa eḡe zamare borofadu ḡa eꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae reirotaꞌaꞌe zeḡe zuni ederoga urateꞌohe.
Mama duduḡa hune, raha azaḡaꞌe ḡa aḡuꞌa, rehano e ḡaꞌe edeḡa. Ebu eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ḡaeꞌa eḡe tuḡuhirotaꞌaꞌe edeḡa.
E zeḡe mazao ḡa ihoziro ebu barebare ihoziꞌuma. Aꞌe ḡaꞌa e zamare borofiroteꞌe teige, zeḡe zuni vaze ꞌahogaꞌahoga zamare borofoga zu e zeḡe teite tiburanoga veize raꞌohe.”
